item.title: Drone-backed militants attack Nigerian army base, several soldiers dead
item.description: MAIDUGURI, Nigeria (Reuters): Islamist militants backed by armed drones raided an army base in Nigeria’s northeastern Borno state, killing several troops in the early hours of Thursday, the military said, in the second assault reported there this week. item.title: Kremlin: Room for negotiation on Iran ‘not exhausted’
item.description: MOSCOW (AFP): The Kremlin said on Thursday there was still room for negotiations in the standoff between ally Tehran and Washington, after US President Donald Trump threatened new military strikes on Iran. item.title: Taiwan completes first undersea trial for domestically made submarine
item.description: TAIPEI (Reuters): Taiwan completed the maiden underwater sea trial for its first domestically developed submarine on Thursday (Jan 29), a big milestone in a project aimed at strengthening deterrence against the Chinese navy and protecting vital sea lanes in the event of war. item.title: Low risk of Nipah virus spread beyond India, says WHO
item.description: HYDERABAD (Reuters): The risk of the deadly Nipah virus ‌spreading ‌from ‌India ⁠is low, ‌the World Health Organization said on Friday, ⁠adding ‌that it ‍does ‍not ‍recommend any travel or trade restrictions after the South Asian ⁠nation reported two cases of the virus infection.

item.description: WASHINGTON (Reuters): The administration of President Donald Trump lifted some sanctions on Venezuela’s oil industry on Thursday to make it easier for US companies to sell its crude oil, and said more restrictions on the country would be lifted soon.
